candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable (~2s), propagating 503 from inventory and 502 at gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory causing 503, then 502 at gateway checkout; logs and metrics corroborate ~2s checkout latency and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis path. Bounded to redis-timeout.
